Name: Idea Review
Purpose: Run the core evidence-based review of an existing R&D idea.
Prompt: Review the idea against current Knowledge Sheet context and available evidence. Answer: Is the evidence sufficient? Does the technology exist? Is the mechanism reasonable? Is there competitor adoption or a relevant precedent? Is there supplier/technology support? Is there a Knowledge Sheet gap? What research is needed? Does the idea need modification? Separate verified facts, inference, assumptions, unknowns and proposed changes.

Name: Technology Existence Check
Purpose: Verify whether the technology or architecture in an idea actually exists.
Prompt: Check manufacturer, supplier, technical and commercial evidence. Distinguish direct evidence that the technology exists from inferred or adjacent precedents. State limitations and remaining unknowns.

Name: Mechanism Check
Purpose: Check whether the proposed mechanism is technically reasonable.
Prompt: Review the physical principle, mechanism, flow path or architecture using available technical evidence. Separate supported mechanism from inference and identify the key unknowns or verification needs.

Name: Competitor Precedent Check
Purpose: Check whether competitors or commercial precedents have adopted the relevant technology.
Prompt: Identify direct, alternative and adjacent precedents. Use product evidence for existence/advertised function and technical evidence where internal mechanism matters. State what is and is not demonstrated.

Name: Supplier Technology Check
Purpose: Check whether suppliers or technologies exist to support implementation.
Prompt: Identify relevant supplier/component/process technology evidence and practical sourcing constraints. Do not infer a specific grade, capability or integration level without evidence.

Name: Knowledge Gap Check
Purpose: Identify gaps between the idea and the current Knowledge Sheet.
Prompt: Compare the idea with relevant Knowledge Sheet records. State missing knowledge, why it matters, whether it is reusable, and whether a Knowledge Candidate should be proposed.

Name: Research Request
Purpose: Turn unresolved Idea Review gaps into a targeted maintainer research request.
Prompt: State objective, decision, current evidence, exact gap, requested research scope and stop condition. Keep research limited to what can change the idea decision.

Name: Idea Modification
Purpose: Modify an existing idea using verified evidence and review findings.
Prompt: Preserve the core intent where possible, but change mechanism, technology, application, architecture or assumptions when evidence supports the change. Explain the evidence basis for each material modification.

Name: Idea Synthesis
Purpose: Produce a concise reviewed version of an idea for the next decision.
Prompt: Synthesize evidence, technology status, mechanism assessment, competitor/supplier support, Knowledge Sheet gaps, research needs, proposed modifications and next action. Keep verified findings separate from inference and proposal.

Name: Knowledge Candidate
Purpose: Identify reusable knowledge discovered during Idea Review.
Prompt: Extract only durable findings useful beyond the current idea. Include evidence, relationship to existing records, reuse reason, and verification needed. Human review is required before Knowledge Sheet write-back.
